name: Sanada Kazan
source:
Red Edition Route

The protagonist’s childhood friend.

A passionate and dependable high school freshman who lives up to his name, “Volcano.”

He is the heir to the “Sanada Group,” though he doesn’t like to talk about it.

He is a devoted character who has a one-sided crush on the protagonist.
